node.statement: Harmonic identity: for the fixed pivot s and every coordinate index t, sum_j beta_s(j)*a_t(j) equals 1 if t=s and equals 0 if t!=s; consequently sum_j beta_s(j)*lambda_s(j)=0. This follows from the row identity p_{u_s}P=p_{u_s} (because P^2=P), from p_j=sum_t a_t(j)p_{u_t}, from uniqueness of coordinates in the pivot-row basis, and from sum_j beta_s(j)=1 by the row-sum-one condition.
